headline: "80 Million Won → 40 Million Won" Worse Than Hynix… Halved, Union Demands 30% of Operating Profit as Bonus, What About HD Hyundai Heavy Industries?
summary: HD Hyundai Heavy Industries' share price has halved from its peak despite strong earnings. The union is demanding 30% of operating profit as a bonus.
why: HD Hyundai Heavy Industries is a South Korean shipbuilder and offshore engineering company. Its results and labor costs affect its valuation and margins.
